features.name: E-Invoice Matching with Copilot
features.description: A Copilot feature that automatically matches lines between electronic invoices and purchase orders using semantic and text-based matching, supporting one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one scenarios with text similarity threshold and LLM assistance.
features.status_evidence_quote: e invoice matching with co-pilot is in public preview that me this is still not General available
caveats: Available only in Business Central Online, not on-premises
Only in English languages officially supported
Not available in Canada due to regulatory issues
Requires copilot capability to be enabled
Manual review may be needed for out-of-range cost differences

features.name: E-Document Manual Mapping Page
features.description: A new page that allows users to manually map lines between electronic documents and purchase orders, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many mappings before Copilot assistance.
caveats: Manual mapping can be time-consuming with many lines
Still effective for simple scenarios with few lines

features.name: Automatic 80% Text Similarity Matching
features.description: System automatically matches lines when description similarity is 80% or more without invoking the LLM, reducing unnecessary AI model calls.
caveats: Only applies to text description similarity
Different descriptions may require Copilot intervention

features.name: Price Validation Control
features.description: By default, matched prices must be 100% identical, but users can configure price tolerance settings for each item or scenario as needed.
caveats: Default strict price matching may require manual override for discounts
Setup required for price tolerance per item

features.name: Received Quantity Control
features.description: System prevents matching more on an invoice than has been received to avoid billing errors.
caveats: Control applies to prevent over-invoicing on received quantities

features.name: Role Center Queue Indicators
features.description: Extended Role Centers with additional cues showing purchase order matching status to help users easily identify orders that need manual mapping.
caveats: Queue indicators only show status, do not perform matching

features.name: Automatic Purchase Invoice Creation from E-Documents
features.description: System automatically creates purchase invoices from electronic documents when vendor is configured for invoice-only workflow, using general ledger mapping and item references.
caveats: Requires vendor to be configured for invoice-only processing
Limited to vendors without complex purchase order scenarios

features.name: Automatic Purchase Order Creation from E-Documents
features.description: When vendor is configured for purchase order workflow and no active orders exist, system automatically creates a new purchase order from the electronic invoice.
caveats: Only creates new orders when none exist for vendor
Matches against existing orders when available

features.name: Auto-population of Vendor and Document Details
features.description: After matching e-invoice to purchase order and accepting Copilot proposal, the vendor invoice number and document date are automatically populated.

features.name: Cost Tolerance Configuration
features.description: Allows users to set an acceptable cost difference percentage in Purchase and Payables setup so Copilot can accept price variations instead of requiring exact matches.
caveats: Must be configured in Purchase and Payables setup

features.name: Matching Status Color Indicators
features.description: Visual color coding shows the match quality between e-invoice and purchase order line prices: green for 100% match, yellow for within acceptable range, red for outside range.

features.name: Discard and Manual Matching Fallback
features.description: Users can discard a Copilot matching proposal and return to manual matching mode if they do not agree with the suggested matches.

features.name: Drill-down View for Matching Details
features.description: Users can expand individual matching proposals to see detailed line information including e-document description, purchase order description, and cost.

features.name: Copilot for Sales Line Suggestion
features.description: A separate Copilot feature that suggests sales order lines, available in the same release.

features.name: AI-powered Analyze with Copilot
features.description: A Copilot feature for analysis tasks, available in the same release.

features.name: Chat with Copilot
features.description: A general chat interface with Copilot, available in the release.

features.name: Extend Copilot using AL code
features.description: Partners can extend Copilot functionality using AL code for partner-specific, industry-specific, or local scenarios.

features.name: Manual Document Matching in E-Documents
features.description: The release includes improvements to manual matching for e-documents, available when Copilot cannot be used or as an alternative workflow.
